title: Экспорт — Loginom Data файл
semantics: Export one current input table to a new LGD using native LZ4 and compressed-data checksum. parameters.lgd_export requires destination, compression, checksum, overwrite=reject on creation. Preserve field names, labels, scalar types, data kinds, field/row order and NULL versus empty string. No training. Execute returns output.file_artifacts; read.ports=[]. Done saves settings; Close discards draft. No append, overwrite, variables, DDF or other compression.

parameter_schema.description: New export requires all lgd_export fields; existing {} preserves settings.

lgd_export.description: One new LGD file in native default compression mode.

destination.description: Absolute new .lgd path in own selected export directory.

compression.description: Native observed LZ4; no LZO or uncompressed mode.

checksum.description: Observed native checksum of compressed data.

overwrite.description: Reject an existing destination; no replace or append.
